signers.description: Primary-key fingerprints whose signature is accepted for a source. Each has an armored key at keys/<FINGERPRINT>.asc; a signature by any other key is refused.

tarball_source.description: A kernel.org release tarball. Its detached signature covers the uncompressed tar; sha256 pins the .tar.xz as downloaded.

git_tag_source.description: A signed tag of a kernel git repository, for a release that has no signed tarball (a release candidate). git verify-tag checks the tag, and it must point at the pinned commit.

source.description: Where the stream's kernel source comes from and how it is proven (docs/adr/0008). scripts/fetch-kernel-source.sh refuses a source whose signature or pin does not hold.

architectures.description: The architectures every stream is built for, keyed by the name this forge uses (kconfig/<arch>.config, the build matrix).

kernel_arch.description: The ARCH= value the kernel build takes.

base_config.description: The in-tree defconfig target the fragments are merged onto.

cross_compile.description: The CROSS_COMPILE prefix of the GNU toolchain for this architecture. It is set on every host, the native one included, so compiler-dependent symbols resolve against the compiler that builds.

debian_arch.description: The Debian architecture of the packages bindeb-pkg builds for it; the artifact gate refuses a package of any other.

requirements.description: Kernel requirement documents (aegis.p01-nucleus.kernel-requirement.v1) checked by verify-requirements.yml. A dispatched source's dispatch carries a ref and sha256 that are proven before the document is used; the others are read at the resolved commit of their default branch. Labels are unique and every bound stream is a key of streams (tests/test_verify_kernel_requirement.py).

path.description: Repository-relative path; every segment starts with a character other than a dot, so '.', '..' and an absolute path are refused.

streams.description: The streams this consumer is bound to. Every bound stream must satisfy the document; the other streams are reported as information only.

requirement_schema.description: The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) the contract owner publishes for the requirement documents, pinned by commit and sha256, and the copy vendored for the offline tests. It applies to every row of requirements. verify-requirements.yml fetches it at the commit, checks the digest and validates each fetched document against it before the verifier runs (docs/adr/0010). To refresh it, see docs/streams.md.

path.description: Repository-relative path in the owner's repository, by the same grammar as the paths of requirements.

commit.description: The full commit the schema is read at.

sha256.description: The digest of the schema file at that commit.

vendored.description: This repository's copy of the schema, byte-identical to the pinned file (tests/test_requirement_schema.py).
